title: 新动漫风格
prompt: Transform this image into a 1960s Tezuka-style illustration. Use big, rounded expressive eyes with bright highlights. Simplify the anatomy with soft, rounded limbs and clean linework. Avoid detailed textures — focus on smooth color fills and strong silhouettes. The final image should resemble a vintage anime frame from Astro Boy, with an optimistic, futuristic feel.
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro，轻松将图像转换为复古未来风格的 1960 年代手冢治虫动漫艺术，适合动画工作室和漫画创作者打造线条简洁、角色生动的乐观科幻视觉。
